evidence.title: Figure Signs Agreement with Catalyst Brands to Scale Humanoid Operations
evidence.excerpt: Figure Signs Agreement with Catalyst Brands to Scale Humanoid Operations FIGURE 03 HELIX COMPANY NEWS CAREERS Figure Signs Agreement with Catalyst Brands to Scale Humanoid Operations May 26, 2026 Today we are announcing a commercial agreement with Catalyst Brands to deploy Figure humanoids into their distribution and logistics network. The collaboration starts at Catalyst’s Reno, Nevada Distribution Logistics Center, focusing on automating physically demanding tasks within the supply chain. Catalyst Brands - which operates iconic retail brands including JCPenney, Aéropostale, and Brooks Brothers - is in an ambitious expansion phase. Figure’s next-gen robots provide Catalyst with a flexible solution that can be deployed across a diverse, multi-brand portfolio instantly. The partnership will establish the playbook for how AI-driven hardware can serve as a primary growth engine for modern holding companies. This announcement underpins the commercial momentum as Figure continues to lead the transformation of the global workforce: Deployment at Scale: We are seamlessly integrating into Catalyst's distribution facility. Humanoids are the only form factor with this ability. Workforce Mode
